sourceNotes: 网络监视器新增实时与历史视图
网络监视器新增上下行流量趋势，需更新独立网络组件至1.0.2
连接地图支持展开、缩放与拖动
通用设置新增“启动时显示主窗口”开关
优化网络监视器布局、同名应用分组与程序名称识别，分别显示内网地址和位置未知
Homebrew 筛选新增“手动安装”，可快速区分主动安装的软件包与依赖
后台守护进程列表新增已卸载应用残留启动项的手动移除提示
内存弹窗默认显示“压缩与交换”，保留已启用的自定义显示选择（#23）
保留新旧主程序与网络组件之间的连接查看和组件管理兼容性，支持分别升级

en: Add live and history views to Network Monitor. Keep the last 15 minutes of connection and traffic history on this Mac, with linked app, process, domain and region filters.
Add upload and download traffic trends. Update the independently installed network component to 1.0.2 to use them; saved history remains available after collection stops.
Expand, zoom and pan the connection map. Show province, city and provider details for mainland China IPs, group map markers by city and expand provinces and cities in the region list.
Add Show Main Window at Launch in General settings. Turn it off to keep manual launches in the background; login launches continue to run in the background (#23).
Refine the Network Monitor layout, group apps with the same name, improve executable names and distinguish private addresses from unknown locations.
Add a Manually Installed Homebrew filter to distinguish explicitly installed packages from dependencies.
Add manual removal guidance for leftover startup entries from uninstalled apps in the background daemon list.
Show compressed memory and swap by default in the memory popover while preserving existing custom selections (#23).
Preserve connection viewing and component management compatibility between old and new apps and network components so either can be upgraded first.
